decisions.reason: Changing SPI MOSI from GPIO26 to GPIO33 does not alter the I2C bus speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or signal conditioning.
The source changes the MCU assignment for SPI MOSI, which is not part of the documented power-to-main connector pinouts or connector-order policy.
The source changes only SPI MOSI to GPIO33 and does not change the 5V rail's GPIO5 enable assignment or its switching behavior.
The SPI MOSI GPIO reassignment does not alter the LEDs' 5V supply or required data-level shifter.
The source resolves the SPI MOSI assignment only and does not necessarily change the LED power-cutoff control GPIO or standby-current requirement.
The SPI MOSI GPIO reassignment does not affect the standalone LDO, source OR-ing, activation condition, or powered 3.3V rail.
The source does not change the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, or VSYS power-path topology.
Selecting GPIO33 for SPI MOSI does not change any component sourcing, availability, cost, or connector-selection requirement.
The sensor board's general role of providing sensor connectors remains valid and unchanged by the main-board SPI MOSI GPIO reassignment.
